storage: Airtight jar in a cool, dark cupboard; keep the spoon dry.
looksLike: A fine, earthy-brown to khaki ground spice with a warm, slightly bitter, nutty smell, sold in 100 g and 200 g cartons and pouches.
howToPick: Look for a uniform khaki-brown powder with a strong cumin smell; a faded colour, clumps or a flat smell suggest age. For best taste dry-roast whole seeds and grind them.
shelfLife: About 6 to 12 months once opened, if kept airtight (general guidance; not taken from a source in this run). (general guidance; not taken from a source in this run)
substitutes: Plain cumin powder, lightly dry-roasted in a pan
